translation: Gods ⟨of⟩ pouring thou shalt not make for ⟨yourself⟩.

tokens.meaning: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially)
properly, a pouring over, i.e. fusion of metal (especially a cast image); by implication
not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
to do or make, in the broadest sense and widest application
